overlap_policy: A shared source is counted once in unique_available_sources; per-origin counts intentionally overlap, never measure effort.

packages.limits: No package is declared removable. Identical embedded runtimes do not make version-specific source, saves, PCKs or notices redundant; no extraction or execution occurred.

preserved_archive_sources.limits: Pinned selected extracts, not complete historical repository/runtime. Rave members overlap its readable snapshot; do not double-count unique knowledge.
